name: demo_i4_pipes
source: [AS] assumed generic 2.0 L naturally-aspirated I4 for tools/ps_engine_audio's demo/listening test (ps_audio A10). NOT a real engine - every geometry/table value is a plausible, unmeasured [AS] guess, deliberately mirroring tests/support/cycle_fixtures.h's generic fixture geometry (bore/stroke/valves/lift) and tests/support/cycle_pipe_fixtures.h's generic pipe geometry (intake runners/plenum, exhaust primaries/merge tree), so this file's own map-generation cost/behaviour matches what those tests already exercise. cycle.resolution is not set: the live audio path uses the ResolutionCycleDesc default audio dx (0.032 m exhaust / 0.017 m intake). ps_audio A10 had doubled it to 0.064/0.034 m to avoid a NaN blow-up about 0.9 s after a WOT hold closed; ps_audio A8b traced that to a CFL violation, not to this file: at valve overlap under the near-vacuum overrun manifold the cylinder blows a supersonic (Mach ~2, |u|+a ~1260 m/s) backflow jet into the intake runner, beyond the build-time CFL check's assumed intake wave speed (500 m/s), and the explicit update diverged. PipeNetwork now sub-cycles a pipe whose runtime CFL exceeds the limit (tests/unit/test_pipe_network.cpp P9, tests/unit/test_engine_rig_audio.cpp A8b B1), so the default dx is stable.

cycle.source: [AS] assumed generic cycle-model inputs, not measured - mirrors tests/support/cycle_fixtures.h::make_generic_i4_cycle_desc() (geometry/valves/lift/friction) and tests/support/cycle_pipe_fixtures.h::make_pipe_i4_cycle_desc() (pipe geometry). No real engine's cited data was used.
